Summarise a Delphi data object

Source: R/methods.R
summary.delphi_data.Rd

Provides an overview of the panel and, for each indicator, a compact table of item medians and IQRs by round. Items that reach consensus under the IQR rule of delphi_consensus() are marked with *.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'delphi_data'
summary(
  object,
  type = 7,
  threshold = 0.2,
  relative_to = c("points", "range"),
  ...
)

Arguments

object

A delphi_data object.

type

Quantile algorithm, see delphi_describe().

threshold, relative_to

Consensus rule, see delphi_consensus().

...

Ignored.

Value

An object of class summary.delphi_data: a list with the panel table (panel, see delphi_panel()), the full descriptive table (describe, see delphi_describe()), the consensus table (consensus, see delphi_consensus()) and the scales (scales).

Examples

x <- delphi_data(delphi_example, expert_col = "expert",
                 round_col = "round", indicator_col = "indicator",
                 scale = list(impact = c(1, 10), plausibility = c(1, 100)))
s <- summary(x)
s
